metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the call, the afternoon at home, the shut door, and a Christmas line struck down to expected.

yesterday: The court removes to Richmond today, and my lord with it. You will be sent for. Pay is another office's question.
My lord heard of the king from four persons. That is all that was to be said.
If the company is sent for, it goes. John and George will stand for it when there is a door.
The stock holds six pound. Six pound is the cost of going. The Christmas line at home says expected.
Tomorrow's morning is the Capulet kitchen. The afternoon is the king.
